Method of Attack: Ransomware used in targeted attacks against enterprises and businesses
Discoverer: NCC Group's Fox-IT security research team
Attack Vector: Hacking into sites to insert malicious code displaying fake software update alerts from SocGholish fake update framework
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes containing protonmail.com and tutanota.com email addresses
Encrypted files with extensions combining 'wasted' and victim's initials (e.g., .eswasted, .acwasted)
